title: Layer Model — Required and Optional Fields
description: Complete field reference for creating and updating Layers via the admin API (POST/PATCH /api/admin/layers).

required_fields.slug: URL-safe identifier. Format: alphanumeric with hyphens or underscores. E.g. 'ndvi-2023' or 'forest_cover'. Must be globally unique.
required_fields.interaction_config: JSON object controlling popup content. Minimum valid value: {}. Canonical managed configs differ by provider: COG layers use the TiTiler point-query template; imported Martin layers usually use an output array generated from table columns.
required_fields.name: Human-readable display name (translated). Plain string.

important_optional_fields.layer_config: JSON string with provider-specific tile configuration. Effectively required for all useful providers, and strictly required for cog layers by model validation.
important_optional_fields.layer_group_id: Integer ID of the LayerGroup to assign this layer to.
important_optional_fields.opacity: Float 0.0–1.0, default null (treated as 1.0 in frontend).
important_optional_fields.published: Boolean, default true. Set false to hide from public.
important_optional_fields.zoom_max: Maximum zoom level (0–24), default 24. Must be >= zoom_min.
important_optional_fields.order: Integer display order within the layer group.
important_optional_fields.download: Boolean, default false. Enables download button.
important_optional_fields.dataset_shortname: Short citation name for the dataset source.
important_optional_fields.dataset_source_url: URL to the original data source.
important_optional_fields.analysis_suitable: Boolean. Marks layer as available for analysis tools.
important_optional_fields.color: Hex color string for legend swatch, e.g. '#2ecc71'.

interaction_config_examples.description: Martin popup generated from table columns

analysis_expectations.analysis_suitable: When true, analysis_type becomes constrained by the provider.
analysis_expectations.text_analysis: The analysis_type enum still includes 'text' historically, but current model validation does not allow it for analysis_suitable layers in normal create/update flows.
